findings.finding: At least six code paths can mutate candidate promotion status; four bypass nebula.set_candidate_status (stage3 PATCH, tackle candidate_promote, tackle planner, control-edge cpfPromote).
stage3 promotes in two steps: POST spawn-requirement, then PATCH status. A crash between them leaves a requirement without a promoted candidate (or vice versa).

findings.evidence: information_schema.role_table_grants; V146's C1 finding repeats here
findings.finding: Every service connects as pguser, which holds INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on nebula.harvest_candidates_history and semantics.canonical_asset. 'Zero direct writers' cannot be certified until distinct app roles exist.
Identity coverage is incomplete: 7,588 of 11,672 candidates have no asset_id; 3,372 active candidate assets are orphans; 3,370 candidate assets carry no canonical_key.
resolution.canonical_asset holds 13 rows with canonical_key = NULL (the W-A3 unidentified set); the mirror cannot be promoted as authoritative until W-A3 dispositions land.
Voyager mint paths UPDATE canonical_key in place on conflict, while candidate backfill uses DO NOTHING. Two incompatible identity policies on the same table.
All 21 promoted-candidate requirements link to conduit plan 0005 because stage3 hard-codes planRef='0005'; there is no per-candidate plan/WR lineage.
The shortlist timer is disabled while stage1 writers remain in the tree; a routine 'start all timers' action would re-introduce a second manifest emitter.
Alternate runtimes (moleculer/nebula, adonisjs control-edge) and the nexus-janitor clone carry full competing write surfaces but are not listening; they are deployable bypasses.
Candidate status vocabulary has drifted: 11,624 NULL, 21 promoted, plus active/approved/rejected/superseded/struck values outside the transition function's vocabulary.
nebula.set_candidate_status exists in the live DB and the CI bootstrap dump, but has no versioned V-migration; the canonical transition function can drift from the repo.
26 candidate->plan cross-reference edges exist for 21 promoted candidates; five are legacy/extra and have no explicit disposition.
harvest_candidate_embeddings are keyed by harvest_id + candidate_index, not candidate_id, so embeddings cannot be joined to promotion identity without a title/index recipe.
